opsCommon.noCompany: No company to show. Ask Admin to give you a role in a company.
opsCommon.readOnly: Read-only view: you can see this but not change it.
opsCommon.noRight: You don't have the right for this. Ask Admin.
opsCommon.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded: {{detail}}

rules.jobwork.party: Choose the job worker from the supplier list.
rules.jobwork.party_other_company: This job worker is not set up for this company. Add the company on the supplier first.
rules.jobwork.process: Say what the job worker will do (machining, plating …).
rules.jobwork.goods_kind: Choose inputs, capital goods or moulds and tools.
rules.jobwork.no_gstin: The sending branch has no GSTIN. Set it on Branches and GSTINs.
rules.jobwork.limit_not_set: The return limit for this kind of goods is not set. Admin records it on Settings with the CA.
rules.jobwork.closed: Everything on this challan is already back.
rules.jobwork.date: Goods cannot come back before they were sent.
rules.jobwork.line: That line is not on this challan.
rules.jobwork.kind: Choose finished, returned, scrap or loss.
rules.jobwork.returned_item: Returned goods are the same item that was sent.
rules.jobwork.returned_qty: Returned goods settle the same quantity.
rules.jobwork.loss_qty: A process loss brings nothing back; enter only the input it used.
rules.jobwork.input_qty: Enter how much of the sent goods this used.
rules.jobwork.over_balance: More than what is still with the job worker. Nothing was received.
rules.repair.title: Say what is wrong.
rules.repair.status: Close a request with Done instead.
rules.repair.purchase_request: Link a purchase request of this company.
rules.repair.restore_before_breakdown: The machine cannot run again before it broke down.
rules.spares.no_lines: Add the spares or oil issued.
rules.schedule.title: Name the service (oil change, heater check …).
rules.licence.blocks: A licence can block production or packing only.
rules.licence.owner: Choose the owner from the people list.
rules.licence.cancelled: A cancelled licence is not renewed. Enter the new licence instead.
rules.licence.not_later: The renewed licence must run beyond the current expiry date.
rules.licence.duplicate: Another licence of this kind already has that number.
rules.licence.document_folder: Licence files go in this company's licences folder.
rules.licence.no_number: Enter the licence number exactly as printed.
rules.licence.dates: Check the dates: valid-from is needed and valid-to cannot be before it.
rules.licence.expired: A licence this step needs has expired or is missing. Record the renewal on Licences.
rules.licence.missing: A licence this step needs is missing. Admin records it on Licences.
rules.depreciation.settings_missing: Depreciation is refused: the method (straight line or written-down value, Schedule II) is not set. The CA decides it and Admin records the setting depreciation.method on Settings.
rules.depreciation.life_not_set: Depreciation is refused: a useful life is missing. The CA sets lives (Schedule II) and Admin records them in depreciation.useful_life_years or on the asset.
rules.depreciation.asset_dates_missing: Depreciation is refused: enter the put-to-use or purchase date on these assets.
rules.depreciation.residual_not_set: Depreciation is refused: the written-down-value method needs a residual value. The CA sets depreciation.residual_pct.
rules.depreciation.period_not_ended: Depreciation for a month is run after the month ends.
rules.depreciation.already_run: Depreciation for this month is already posted.
rules.asset.disposed: This asset is already disposed of.
rules.asset.no_cost: The asset has no cost in the register. Enter it before disposal.
rules.asset.proceeds_account: Choose the account the money went to.
rules.asset.code: Enter the asset code and name.
rules.posting.rule_missing: An account for this posting is not mapped. Admin maps it with the CA on Tally books → posting rules.
rules.partner.name: Enter the partner's name.
rules.partner.inactive: This partner is no longer active.
rules.partner.account_not_set: Set the partner's account (current or loan) on Partners first.
rules.partner.account_other_company: Choose an account of this company.
rules.partner.share_over_100: Share percentages of this company's partners add up to more than 100.
rules.partner.agreement_required: A project investment needs the project and the signed agreement reference.
rules.partner.project: Choose a project of this company.
rules.partner.over_due: More than the company owes this partner on their account.
rules.partner.board_resolution_required: Enter the board resolution reference (and the CA's check) in the note.
rules.partner_request.kind: Choose withdraw, loan, information or project offer.
rules.partner_request.project: Choose the project or describe the offer.
rules.partner_request.question: Write the question.
rules.partner_request.state: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
rules.partner_request.reason: Give the reason for rejecting (at least 5 characters).
rules.companies_act.s185: Companies Act s.185: loans to directors, and to people or firms they are interested in, are restricted. The CA records the allowed exception on Settings first.
rules.companies_act.s186_limit_not_set: Companies Act s.186: the loan limit is not set. The CA works it out and Admin records it on Settings.
rules.companies_act.s186_limit: Companies Act s.186: this loan takes the company over its limit. It needs a special resolution and the CA's check.
rules.companies_act.director_declaration: Money lent by a director needs their written declaration that it is not borrowed. Record it on Directors first.
rules.loan.kind: Choose given or taken, advance or repayment.
rules.loan.request: Link the approved loan request of this partner.
rules.loan.over_repaid: More than what is outstanding on this loan.
rules.minutes.not_draft: Approved minutes do not change. Record new minutes.
rules.minutes.ref: Enter the meeting date and the minutes reference.
rules.minutes.partner: An incentive goes to a partner of this company.
rules.minutes.pct: Each incentive needs its % of net profit.
rules.minutes.pct_over_100: Incentives cannot exceed the net profit.
rules.minutes.not_approved: Profit is shared only by approved minutes.
rules.profit_share.state: This computation is no longer open.
rules.profit_share.no_profit: The books show no net profit for this year.
rules.profit_share.share_pct_not_100: Partners' share percentages do not add up to 100. Correct them on Partners.
rules.profit_share.already_posted: The profit share for these minutes is already posted.
rules.sod.own_minutes: Another Admin approves the minutes you entered.
rules.sod.own_request: Nobody decides their own request. Another Admin decides it.
rules.sod.doer_is_checker: The person who did a task cannot also check it. Another person checks it.
rules.close.exists: This month already has a checklist.
rules.close.title: Name the task.
rules.close.task_state: This task is not in a state for that action.
rules.close.not_doer: This task is assigned to someone else to do.
rules.close.not_checker: This task is checked by someone else.
rules.close.note: Say what needs fixing (at least 5 characters).
rules.close.reason: Say why it moves to next month (at least 5 characters).
rules.close.tasks_open: Some checklist tasks are not done and checked. Finish them or move them to next month.
rules.close.month_not_over: A month is closed after it ends.
rules.period.closed: This month is closed. Nothing can be posted into it, under any right. Only Admin can reopen it, with a reason.
rules.period.missing: That month is not open for this company yet.
rules.period.reopen_admin_only: Only Admin can reopen a closed month.
rules.period.reason_required: Give the reason for reopening (at least 10 characters). It goes to the user log.
rules.period.no_fy: No financial year is open for that date.
rules.date.future: The date is in the future.
rules.stock.insufficient: Not enough stock at that place.
rules.stock.qty: The quantity must be above zero.
rules.stock.place_other_company: Choose a place of this company.
rules.numbering.no_series: No number series for this document. Admin adds it on Numbering & IDs.
